description: This file is a shell script defining functions and logic for configuring and managing a 3G network interface, including initialization, setup, and teardown procedures, with integration points for external scripts and utilities.

methods.name: proto_3g_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the 3G protocol configuration with device and service parameters.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 3G connection based on configuration parameters, manages device state, PIN, and carrier detection, and initiates PPP connection.

methods.name: proto_3g_teardown
methods.description: Kills the 3G protocol process, effectively tearing down the connection.
